purpose: Frozen validity/ceiling control contract for GOLD (diagnostic floor) and SELECT_ALL (maximal ceiling). Predeclared before outcomes; governs task invalidation, never selector tuning.

GOLD.expected: under correct oracle-patch semantics GOLD reconstructs the complete reference non-test patch (all historically changed non-test files) for an otherwise valid task
GOLD.meaning_of_gold_pass: instrument sanity: the scoped reference patch restricted to all historically changed non-test files satisfies the frozen behavior + preservation contract

meaning_of_gold_fail.if_due_to_behavior_or_preservation_contr: task is OPWS_INVALID (OPWS_INVALID_CONTROL_FAILURE) and is NOT counted as an arm scientific failure

SELECT_ALL.expected: under correct oracle-patch semantics SELECT_ALL reconstructs the complete reference non-test patch for an otherwise valid task when the reference patch's non-test files are all inside the frozen selectable universe
SELECT_ALL.meaning_of_select_all_fail: if SELECT_ALL fails for a reason attributable to the behavior/preservation contract on a task where GOLD passes with the SAME effective reference patch, task is OPWS_INVALID (OPWS_INVALID_CONTROL_FAILURE); never a selector scientific failure
SELECT_ALL.ceiling_purpose: provides a maximal-scope anchor on the sufficiency-scope frontier

predeclared_rules: If GOLD fails for a reason attributable to the behavior/preservation contract, the task is OPWS_INVALID_CONTROL_FAILURE and is NOT counted as an arm scientific failure. Report the task and reason.

If SELECT_ALL and GOLD DISAGREE where their EFFECTIVE REFERENCE PATCH is identical (same set of reference non-test files), classify the task as HARNESS_CONSISTENCY_FAILURE and report it; do not tune selectors based on such cases.
No silent exclusions. Every invalidated task and reason is written to OPWS_INVALID_TASKS.json.

Effective-reference-patch equality is defined by the identity tuple: same task, same reference non-test file set reachable by each control arm's scope, same behavior contract, same preservation contract, same environment.
The ceiling meaning of SELECT_ALL is scope-maximal, not 'perfect selector'. The frontier shows SELECT_ALL at its maximal scope size.

harness_consistency_failure.meaning: GOLD and SELECT_ALL disagree where their effective reference patch is identical
harness_consistency_failure.action: report in OPWS_INVALID_TASKS.json; owner review; never used to alter selectors
